summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 tests) under the shared venv. Nothing is committed. Deviation: the module imports BNode from rdflib.term, which is not on the spec's allowed list. It is needed so that None is not treated as a graph wildcard. Not verified: mypy, black, ruff, and isort are not installed in the venv, so the type-check gate and formatting were checked by reading the code only.
